admin.actionFailed: The operation failed. Try again, or check the backend logs.

login.heading: Command post
login.keyHint: The key opens synchronisation, roster management and campaign controls.
login.title: Administration

groups.repairHint: These replay history that is already written. Run them when a figure is wrong, not as part of an ordinary week.
groups.routineHint: The ordinary gestures of a week, with no retroactive effect.

recalculate.heading: Recalculate progress
recalculate.description: Rebuilds this week's challenge progress and the ranking from the matches already stored. Never calls the Riot API.

redraw.heading: Redraw the challenges
redraw.description: Throws away the current week's five challenges, draws five new ones from the catalogue as it now stands, then rebuilds progress and ranking. Use it when the draw itself became wrong: a challenge disabled or removed from the catalogue after the week opened.
redraw.confirmBody: The progress recorded against the discarded challenges is deleted with them: a player who had completed one loses that completion, and the damage it dealt to the week's boss with it. Only the week in progress is touched. Remember to recompute the colony afterwards.

rollover.heading: Run the rollover
rollover.description: Replays Monday's whole rollover: finalizes every past week left open, settles the boss fights they never resolved, and opens the current week. It does not synchronize — run a synchronization first if the last matches are still missing.

syncAll.heading: Synchronize the squad
syncAll.description: Imports the current season's matches for every tracked player, then rebuilds progress and ranking. Several minutes, depending on the Riot rate limit.
syncAll.accepted: Synchronization started. Follow its progress in the panel above.

syncPlayer.heading: Synchronize one player
syncPlayer.description: Catches up a single player without replaying the others. Useful after an isolated failure during a scheduled run.

weekSelection.heading: Open the week
weekSelection.description: Draws the current week's missing challenges and its boss, exactly as Monday's rollover does. Does nothing when the week is already set up.
weekSelection.done: The current week is fully set up.

campaignReplay.heading: Replay the campaign
campaignReplay.description: Replays the running campaign from its first day, from the matches and challenges already stored. Safe: the base is never advanced incrementally, it is always recomputed in full.

players.archived: Player archived: closed weeks depend on it. It stays restorable.
players.error: The roster could not be loaded.
players.frozenRoster: Campaign {{run}} runs on a roster frozen at {{roster}} operators. Activating or deactivating someone here only takes effect on the next campaign.

gettingStarted.addPlayers: Add each player with their full Riot ID, in the form name#tag.
gettingStarted.share: Share the app's address with the team. The guided tour opens on its own the first time somebody visits, so nobody has to explain how it works.
gettingStarted.synchronize: Run a first synchronization to pull in their match history. The ranking and the colony fill themselves in every week after that.
gettingStarted.title: Getting started

players.heading: Roster
players.idle: No match in fourteen days. An active player who has stopped playing widens the town without feeding it, and costs around 5 % of the final score.

remove.heading: Remove from the roster
remove.archiveBody: This player took part in the campaign, so it will be archived rather than deleted. It leaves the public application and stops being synchronized, but the closed weeks naming it stay readable. You can restore it later.
remove.deleteBody: This player took part in no campaign, so it will be deleted for good, along with its matches and synchronization traces. This cannot be undone.

players.title: Players

reset.heading: New campaign
reset.description: Clears everything derived from match history, so a new campaign starts from a clean base. The next synchronization re-imports from scratch.

kept.players: The roster and the players' statuses

reset.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Every match, challenge, ranking and boss will be cleared. The roster and the catalogues are kept.
reset.blockedBySync: A synchronization is in progress. Wait for it to finish: it would be writing matches into the base being emptied.
reset.done: Campaign reset. Start a synchronization to re-import the history.

body.lead: They feed a town your squad grows over ten weeks,

header.heading: Bring the wounded home from ten planets

scene.section: The city at night and the rocket under construction
scene.aria: The city at night, {{population}} inhabitants. In the middle, the rocket built to {{stages}} stages out of {{weeks}}, and the dotted outline of the full launcher above.

frieze.title: The campaign
frieze.aria: The ten weeks of the campaign

mission.title: This week's mission
mission.planetAria: {{planet}}, the planet of week {{week}}. Amber marks on its surface stand for the {{wounded}} wounded, and the breakthrough in its lines reaches {{percent}}%.

report.title: Situation report
report.targetNote: Fight on the battlefield, every mode counts, to bring the guardian down. Challenges deal it no damage: they bring the wounded home.
report.groundNote: Build a ship large enough and grow the base to save as many as possible.

capacity.title: Extraction capacity
capacity.carryAria: Components can carry {{count}} wounded out of the {{wounded}} spotted, {{percent}}%.
capacity.shelterAria: Food can shelter {{count}} wounded out of the {{wounded}} spotted, {{percent}}%.
capacity.breachAria: The breakthrough in {{guardian}}'s lines reaches {{percent}}%: only that share of what is ready to board gets away.
capacity.aboardAria: {{count}} wounded would be aboard on Sunday out of the {{wounded}} spotted, {{percent}}%: {{extraction}} by the extraction and {{challenges}} already secured by the challenges.

orders.title: Orders of the day
orders.validatedAria: {{done}} operators out of {{total}} validated the daily challenge.

squad.title: The squad today
squad.footer: Diminishing returns: from the 6th match of the day a match is worth 50%; from the 10th, 25%.

state.error: The campaign could not be read.
state.none: No campaign has been opened yet. The weekly ranking runs; the mission starts with the first campaign.
state.opened: The campaign is open: the mission starts on Monday.
state.closed: The campaign is closed. The next mission waits for a new campaign to open.
state.settling: The week is settled, the mission resumes on Monday.

playerProfile.error: Failed to load this player's profile.

filters.seasonLimit: {{count}} seasons at most, so every curve keeps a colour that can be told apart.

damage.coefficient: Damage dealt to the week's boss. This match kept {{percent}}% of its base value: a day's best games count in full, and the ones after them count for less and less.
damage.unvalued: This match does not count for ValoQuests: the ruleset values neither this mode nor this kind of game.

detail.title: Match detail
detail.teammatesHeading: Other squad members in this match

matches.empty: No match found for these filters.

agents.title: Best agents
agents.tooltip: Win rate, ACS and match count for every agent played in competitive over the selected seasons, most played first.

progression.empty: No competitive match over the selected seasons.
progression.error: Could not load this player's progression.

evolution.alignmentNote: Shorter seasons start further along the axis: every curve ends at the same point, so seasons are compared on where they left off.
evolution.title: Evolution
evolution.tooltip: One value per competitive match, oldest to most recent. With several seasons plotted, the shorter ones are pushed right so they all end on the same abscissa.

maps.title: Best maps
maps.tooltip: Win rate, ACS and match count for every map played in competitive over the selected seasons, most played first.

playStyle.empty: No registered hit over the selected seasons.
playStyle.title: Play style
playStyle.tooltip: Where registered hits landed, by body zone. Worked out from the head, body and leg hits of the filtered competitive matches. Not an accuracy figure: shots that missed entirely are not counted.

records.title: Personal records

tooltip.bestAcs: Best average combat score in a single match. Set on {{map}} as {{agent}}, on {{date}}.
tooltip.bestHeadshotPercentage: Best headshot rate in a match of at least 10 rounds. Set on {{map}} as {{agent}}, on {{date}}.
tooltip.bestKda: Best (kills + assists) / deaths ratio in a single match. Set on {{map}} as {{agent}}, on {{date}}.
tooltip.longestActiveDayStreak: Longest run of consecutive days with at least one match, in any game mode.
tooltip.longestWinStreak: Longest run of consecutive competitive wins. Cancelled matches do not break the run.
tooltip.mostDamage: Most damage dealt in a single match. Set on {{map}} as {{agent}}, on {{date}}.
tooltip.mostKills: Most kills in a single match. Set on {{map}} as {{agent}}, on {{date}}.
tooltip.mvps: Matches finished with the best score of the game.
tooltip.peakTier: Highest competitive rank reached over the selected seasons.

records.tooltipSection: Best performances over the selected seasons. Highs only: nothing is shown until a match has set it.

schedule.threshold: Slots holding fewer than {{count}} matches are greyed out: the sample is too small to conclude anything from.
schedule.title: Performance by schedule
schedule.tooltip: Win rate of competitive matches grouped by day of the week and by three-hour slot, based on when the match started.

table.empty: No data over the selected seasons.

tooltip.acs: Average combat score per round: combat points earned (kills, damage, assists) divided by rounds played, then averaged over the filtered matches.
tooltip.adr: Average damage dealt per round, averaged over the filtered matches.
tooltip.headshotPercentage: Share of registered hits that landed on the head: headshots divided by head + body + leg hits. Shots that missed entirely are not counted.
tooltip.kda: (Kills + assists) divided by deaths, over every filtered match.
tooltip.matchesPlayed: Number of matches matching the current filters.
tooltip.winRate: Share of matches won: wins divided by filtered matches. Cancelled matches count towards the total.
